raw_build_metadata_correction: The build receipt inherited an obsolete Q1 float-guard scope string and container name. Its three-file overlay, source inventories, changed modules and binary hashes identify this halfword experiment.

packed_proof.scope: Independent finite packed-code/address proof; no GPU, model or runtime changes.

address.bounds: Every row16 load lies wholly within logical tensor bytes. Tile32 loads lie within existing four-byte-rounded VulkanBuffer and VK_WHOLE_SIZE binding; final odd-block tensor may read two padding bytes, which are masked and varied independently. No packed halfword crosses a block.

packed_proof.factorization: All65536 halfwords checked at every format group/word position; address/layout/bounds checked independently over odd block/row strides and expert/slice offsets. Payload bits and address arithmetic are independent factors; not a claimed65536-by-all-shapes Cartesian sweep.
packed_proof.limitations: Packed integer codes and halfword-bit transport only. No claim about nonfinite floating payload arithmetic, driver code generation, GPU execution, HF or performance.
packed_proof.preparatory_failure: Initial Python syntax typo else64 refused before execution; corrected spacing before the proof ran. No numerical failure or limit change.

identity.scope: 54 frozen-output CLI identity checks for Q1/Q2 halfword scale/packed-code loads. Printed stdout byte identity, not an internal raw-F32-bit claim. No reference regeneration or budget changes.
identity.status: 54/54 printed stdout byte-identical to frozen Q1/Q2 results; original completed matrix witnesses and bounds match.
identity.limitations: Identity is of complete printed CLI stdout bytes and witnessed precision paths, not a claim of internal raw floating-point bit identity. No reference regeneration. Native kernel/range proof, performance and remaining split/released/depth/project gates remain separate.
